title: Consolidate logger and storage protocols
body:
Merges redundant protocol definitions to reduce fragmentation while preserving backward compatibility.

## Changes

**Logger Protocol (`logger.zod.ts` → `logging.zod.ts`)**
- Consolidated basic logger schemas (`LogLevel`, `LogFormat`, `LoggerConfigSchema`, `LogEntrySchema`) into logging protocol
- Added hierarchical logger support to `LoggingConfigSchema`:
  ```typescript
  export const LoggingConfigSchema = z.object({
    // ...existing fields
    default: LoggerConfigSchema.optional(),        // Kernel's basic logger
    loggers: z.record(LoggerConfigSchema).optional(), // Named component loggers
  });
  ```

**Storage Protocol (`scoped-storage.zod.ts` → `object-storage.zod.ts`)**
- Merged scoped storage into object storage protocol
- Added `StorageScopeSchema` with lifecycle/tenancy scopes (`global`, `tenant`, `user`, `session`, `temp`, `cache`, `data`, `logs`, `config`, `public`)
- Extended `ObjectStorageConfigSchema` with scope-aware fields:
  ```typescript
  export const ObjectStorageConfigSchema = z.object({
    // ...existing fields
    scope: StorageScopeSchema.optional().default('global'),
    location: z.string().optional(),  // For local/scoped storage
    quota: z.number().int().positive().optional(),
    options: z.record(z.any()).optional(), // Provider-specific config
  });
  ```
- Moved `FileMetadataSchema` to unified protocol

## Deleted Files
- `packages/spec/src/system/logger.zod.ts`
- `packages/spec/src/system/scoped-storage.zod.ts`

All exports maintained through consolidated files. No breaking changes.
